author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@gwg Part of the reason I want to explore a "WordPress Only" #indieweb approach is to see if I need WordPress at all. I am staring to see glimpses if something like @withknown was just a MicroPub engine I don't really see. Then I write using stuff like @omnibear directly in my browser and @indigienous on my phone.

Then on my domain I have a page for whatever post I want using a simple API? Or even an RSS feed, but probably an API.

Keep telling faculty let's keep our courses down to the fewest lines of HTML possible but then saying build yourself on this mess we call WordPress. Seems strange.
